scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir src --reload --reload-dir src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run export && bash backend/scripts/prepare.sh
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:worker
